pages.text:
Design
We do not follow design
trends. We set them.
There’s no alternative to
standing out.
In a segment overpopulated with the next best entry-level sedan, Audi chooses not to participate. For Audi,
there are no entry-level vehicles. Our commitment to design ensures that the Audi A4 effortlessly stands
apart. Perfectly proportioned lines stretch across the profile of the vehicle, helping solidify a design lan-
guage that validates the progressive thinking we’ve been recognized for throughout the automotive world.
A number of available trim levels perpetuate our design story, inside and out, making clear our commitment
to the philosophy of building beautifully engineered vehicles. So while we may be limited to participate in a
specific segment, we don’t feel that we have to play along.
